# criblio_notification_template (Resource)

NotificationTemplate Resource

Manages custom Handlebars notification templates in the current workspace. Requires V2 Notifications to be enabled. The provider selects `engine=handlebars` automatically.

Use `criblio_notification_template.<name>.id` as the `template_id` in a notification's `template_target_pairs`. The template's `type` must match the notification target's type. SMTP, Slack, and PagerDuty templates normally contain a JSON payload; Handlebars expressions remain literal template text.

Built-in templates (`default-email`, `default-slack`, `default-sns`, and `default-pagerduty`) cannot be created, updated, or deleted. Read them using the `criblio_notification_template` or `criblio_notification_templates` data source. The import CLI excludes these built-in templates from exported resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_notification_template" "my_notification_template" {
  content = "{\"to\":\"{{metadata.to}}\",\"subject\":\"[{{status}}] {{monitor_name}}\",\"body\":\"{{description}}\"}"
  description = "Custom email notification template"
  id = "custom-email"
  type = "smtp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Handlebars template content. Must be valid for the selected notification target type.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this notification template.
- `type` (String) Notification target type that this template supports. Immutable after creation.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the notification template. Omit to retain the API value, or use an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) User who created the template, populated by the API.
- `engine` (String) Template engine populated by the API (handlebars).
- `last_updated` (Integer) Last update timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_notification_template.my_criblio_notification_template
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_notification_template.my_criblio_notification_template "example"
```
